text.name: Parallel Plumbing
text.rules: Record "parallel plumbing". SAE spends 2 points on one action. LIO chooses: Join the bank? If yes, LIO spends 1 point on actions, then SAE spends 1 point on actions; if no, record "stayed out".
text.history: Brazil, Russia, India and China held their first BRIC summit in Yekaterinburg on 16 June 2009; the China-led Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank opened on 16 January 2016 with 57 founding members, and China has built its own cross-border payment system.
